name: Aletheia
source:
The year is 23XX. A former luxury cruiser now serves as a cryo-transport, carrying over 200 passengers on a 120-year journey to a distant planet.

Everyone is frozen – except two. You wake up 20 years in, with no memory of who you were. Two women greet you, each with a different version of the truth.

[From [url=https://baron-buddies.itch.io/aletheia]Itch.io[/url]]
